fields.description: The actual hidden information or lore text

fields.description: The skill level or perception threshold required to discover this secret

fields.name: discoveryMethod
fields.description: The action required to reveal the secret (e.g., 'inspect', 'interrogate', 'hack')

fields.name: isDiscovered
fields.description: Tracks whether this secret has been revealed to the player or public

proposals.rationale: While the RumorDistortionSystem exists, there is no specific data structure for 'hidden' information. Adding a 'Secret' component to agents or items creates narrative asymmetry, enabling behaviors like blackmail, conspiracy, and discovery that are essential for high-tension storytelling.

data.prose: The high sun ignites the falling rain, casting a surreal, shimmering glow over the Village Square fountain as it stands defiant against the encroaching void. Farmer Willem and Farmer Hilda stumble away from the jagged abyss that was once their livelihood, their eyes fixed on the stone basin where Little Pip waits in eerie stillness. Within the Guard Barracks, a heavy, unexplained silence persists, leaving the village's shield absent while the very earth beneath the Manor begins to groan.

recentProse: Dust rises from the groaning earth in the Farm Fields as Farmer Willem and Farmer Hilda’s voices rise in a sharp dispute, oblivious to the widening fissure at their feet. Under the high sun and falling rain, Little Pip stands alone by the stone fountain, watching the water tremble with each pulse from deep below. The Guard Barracks remain still and silent, a stark contrast to the growing panic beginning to stir in the heart of Willowbrook.

The stone fountain in the Village Square shivers beneath Mayor Aldric’s touch, offering a singular point of cold reality as the ground beneath the nearby Manor begins to fail. In the distance, the Farm Fields buckle with a deafening groan, the widening fissure finally forcing Willem and Hilda to break their bitter cycle of words and flee for their lives. Through the sun-lit rain, all eyes turn toward the silent Guard Barracks, waiting for a Captain who has yet to answer the call of the breaking earth.

The earth beneath the Farm Fields finally surrenders, a jagged fissure swallowing the golden wheat and forcing Farmer Willem and Farmer Hilda to flee the crumbling soil. In the Village Square, Little Pip huddles against the vibrating stone of the fountain as sun-drenched rain masks the sound of the Mayor’s Manor groaning toward collapse. While the heart of Willowbrook fractures, the Guard Barracks remain eerily silent, a hollow fortress in a village losing its ground.

Rain-slicked wheat vanishes into the dark maw of the earth as Farmer Willem and Farmer Hilda flee the crumbling Farm Fields in a panicked rush. In the heart of Willowbrook, Little Pip stands alone by the stone fountain, its steady pulse the only rhythm left as the Mayor's Manor groans and settles under the weight of the shifting ground. Within the silent Guard Barracks, the air grows heavy, yet Captain Helena remains motionless, even as the sun glints off the falling rain and the world outside fractures.

The earth’s violent shuddering forces Farmer Willem and Farmer Hilda to turn their backs on the ruined fields, their voices finally falling silent as they flee toward the village center. In the heart of Willowbrook, Little Pip clings to the cold stone of the fountain, the only thing that remains steady while the world around him groans. Meanwhile, the heavy doors of the Guard Barracks remain ominously shut, leaving the survivors to face the encroaching chaos without their captain.

The midday rain turns to a stinging mist as the Farm Fields vanish into a jagged abyss, forcing Willem and Hilda to flee toward the heart of the village. Little Pip watches from the Village Square as the stone fountain remains unnervingly still, the only piece of Willowbrook that refuses to tremble. High above, the Mayor's Manor groans under the strain, yet the Guard Barracks offer no sign of Captain Helena, leaving the village's defense as hollow as the shifting earth.

Little Pip stands solitary beside the Village Square fountain, the steady splash of water the only constant as the world around him fractures. High above, the midday sun glints through the falling rain, illuminating the deserted Marketplace where Greta the Merchant and Mira the Healer wait in breathless anticipation for a command that has yet to come. The silence from the Guard Barracks grows heavy, a stark contrast to the distant, rhythmic groaning of the earth.

The midday sun glints off the falling rain as Farmer Willem and Farmer Hilda stumble away from the yawning void that was once their livelihood, their eyes fixed on the distant, unwavering stone of the Village Square fountain. Inside the Mayor's Manor, Mayor Aldric feels the floorboards groan with a sickening finality, his hand tightening on Young Emma's shoulder as the grand house settles into the shifting earth. Yet the Guard Barracks remain a tomb of silence, the village’s sworn shield failing to emerge even as the very foundations of Willowbrook surrender to the tremors.

The roar of the collapsing fields follows Farmer Willem and Farmer Hilda as they stumble toward the village center, their breath coming in ragged gasps against the midday rain. In the Village Square, the stone fountain remains an island of impossible stillness while the Mayor's Manor begins to groan under the weight of the shifting foundations. Despite the chaos, a haunting silence still grips the Guard Barracks, where the village's only hope for order remains locked away.

proposals.name: ScarcityIncentiveSystem
proposals.description: Adjusts agent valuation and motivation based on the relative abundance or rarity of resources within their local economy, turning lack of supply into urgent demand.

specification.name: ScarcityIncentiveSystem
specification.description: Adjusts agent valuation and motivation based on the relative abundance or rarity of resources within their local economy, turning lack of supply into urgent demand.
specification.logic: 1. Sample local inventories within the agent's Room or GridPosition to estimate current resource supply. 2. Compare current supply levels against historical averages stored in Agent Memory. 3. If a resource is deemed scarce (supply < threshold), generate or intensify a 'Scarcity' Belief linked to that item type. 4. Calculate a 'Desperation Multiplier' based on the agent's Personality (specifically Greed or Neuroticism) and current Needs. 5. Synthesize or update Goals: 'Acquire [ScarceResource]' receives significantly higher priority; 'Sell [ScarceResource]' is inhibited unless the agent perceives a massive profit margin. 6. Update internal price heuristics in Memory to reflect the new premium status of the item.

proposals.rationale: Currently, all agents have 0 goals. This system would bridge the gap between the 'Needs' component and the 'GoalSynthesisSystem' by generating urgent goals when resource thresholds (food, fuel, tools) drop, forcing agents to participate in the MarketExchangeSystem.

proposals.name: Vocation
proposals.description: Tracks an entity's professional expertise, trade skills, and economic role, governing their ability to craft, negotiate, or perform specialized labor.

specification.name: Vocation
specification.description: Tracks an entity's professional expertise, trade skills, and economic role, governing their ability to craft, negotiate, or perform specialized labor.

fields.name: label
fields.description: The unique identifier for the specific trade or profession (e.g., 'Blacksmith', 'Spice Trader', 'Architect').

fields.name: level
fields.description: The numeric integer representing current proficiency and mastery of the trade.

fields.name: currentXp
fields.description: The current experience points accumulated within the current level.

fields.name: efficiencyMultiplier
fields.description: A floating-point value affecting the speed, quality, or profit margin of tasks associated with this vocation.

proposals.rationale: While agents have titles like 'Blacksmith' or 'Baker', their output capacity isn't codified. This component would define an agent's production efficiency and specific output types, creating the 'Comparative Advantage' necessary to drive meaningful trade rather than simple barter.

event.msg: Little Pip made progress on festival preparations

action.content: A distant clang of metal from the forge pierces the steady patter of rain. Lars must still be working, even this late. I wonder what he's crafting. I wonder what *else* is out there in the world, waiting to be seen.

data.insight: My family's position makes me a central figure in the village's well-being, but also a lightning rod for its anxieties. I need to act decisively and maintain a calm facade to reassure the villagers and protect my family's reputation.

action.content: Willem, did you hear anything just now? Over that way?
You seem to have a lot on your mind, Ada. Is everything alright? The festival preparations can be a lot, I imagine.
